judgments.reasoning_cat1: Read literally it bars disposing of any asset at all outside the Permitted Dispositions list, which would forbid ordinary-course lending, collection and payment activity by a mortgage fund.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: It duplicates and overrides Section 7.3(c)'s "substantial part" test, and sits against Section 4.1's flat statement that Borrowers have no authority to dispose of Collateral except for Permitted Dispositions — three provisions covering the same ground with different quantums.
